explanation: GMT (Greenwich Mean Time), UTC (Coordinated Universal Time), PST (Pacific Standard Time), and EST (Eastern Standard Time) are all widely recognized global time standards or time zone abbreviations. Latitude is a geographical coordinate, unrelated to measuring time zones.

The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Temple of Artemis, and Colossus of Rhodes are all among the traditional Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Machu Picchu is one of the New7Wonders of the World.

Nail, Pin, Bolt, and Screw are all objects that inherently possess a distinct 'head' as a structural or functional component. A Hat is worn on the head, but it does not inherently possess a 'head' component as part of its own structure.
